reasons: CS3244 requires MA2116 (or equivalent) and MA1511+MA1512 (or equivalent). The student has completed MA1521 but not MA1511, MA1512, or MA2116. These math prerequisites cannot be completed before Semester 4 as they are foundational courses typically taken in Year 1, and the student is already in Y1S2 with no record of having taken them.

CS4234 requires CS3230. CS3230 requires CS2040 (or equivalent) and CS1231. The student has CS1231S but needs to take CS2040. CS2040 requires CS1101S (done). However, CS4234 also requires a math prerequisite (MA2001 or MA1522 etc). The student has MA1521 but not MA1522 or MA2001. Even if math prerequisites were met, the dependency chain CS2040 -> CS3230 -> CS4234 pushes CS4234 to at best Semester 5 or 6, but the missing math prerequisites for CS3244 and CS4234 make the plan impossible within the current completed course set.
